hypotheses.title: Isolated paired stations show no macroscopic transfer in null trials
hypotheses.statement: In isolated instrumented stations without ordinary transport, controlled null trials will show no verified material transfer.
hypotheses.falsifier: Blind, independently repeated and calibrated verification of a marked intact object's transfer with conventional explanations excluded.
hypotheses.prediction: No genuine object appears at B during sham runs; characterize sensor false positives and drift.
hypotheses.limitations: Null control establishes measurement reliability, not a portal mechanism.

hypotheses.title: Quantum teleportation is not matter teleportation
hypotheses.statement: Standard quantum teleportation moves quantum-state information rather than the original macroscopic object.
hypotheses.falsifier: Peer-validated physical transport of original macroscopic matter in a standard quantum teleportation protocol.
hypotheses.prediction: Protocol utilizes entanglement and classical communication, without aperture-based object transfer.
hypotheses.limitations: Terminology distinction, not a new physical apparatus hypothesis.
